leadStory: Liverpool's tour ends tonight at Chicago's Soldier Field, where Andoni Iraola hands first summer minutes to Alexander Isak, Florian Wirtz and Ryan Gravenberch and a debut to the £60m Jeremie Jacquet, the spine Liverpool spent a year and the guts of £400m assembling standing on a pitch together for the first time against Leeds.
subject: The Liverpool spine finally together on a floodlit pitch at night, several figures in deep red standing shoulder to shoulder, a bank of stadium light and an upper tier behind, a green pitch raking out of the dark
prompt: Cinematic editorial photograph, night, a small group of footballers in deep-red shirts standing together shoulder to shoulder on a floodlit pitch, a warm rim of floodlight along their backs and cool white light spilling from a bank of stadium lights behind, a shadowed upper tier and floodlight pylons in the distance, a green pitch raking up out of the dark, a quietly assembled, expectant mood rather than celebration, film grain, no on-image text, generous headroom at the top for a masthead headline
